# Cascader

Cascader: a field that picks one path through nested options, one level at a time.

**Import:** `import { Cascader } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/Cascader/Cascader.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/Cascader/Cascader.stories.jsx` — Overview, EmptyPath, PreselectedPath, SpacingDefault, SpacingCompact, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Focused, FieldDisabled, FieldInvalid

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/Cascader/Cascader.mdx`

## Usage

Use `Cascader` when a choice is naturally made one level at a time, in
sequence — a region, then a city, then a neighborhood. For a hierarchy where
someone might pick or see several nodes at once rather than one path, use
`TreeSelect` instead. For a flat list, use `Select`.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name each level by what it is: "Region", "City". | Names that only make sense at one level. |
| Keep each level's options short and parallel. | Mixed kinds of option in one column. |
| Say what to do in an error: "Pick a region". | "Required" or "Invalid". |
| Label the field with the whole path's subject: "Location". | A label for just the first level. |

## Best practices

### Show the path while choosing. {#show-the-path-while-choosing}

An open cascader shows each level beside the last, so the path stays visible. Reopening a field with a path reveals every column up to its level, so any step can be changed without starting from the top.

### Disable a field that has nothing to offer yet. {#disable-a-field-that-has-nothing-to-offer-yet}

A dependent field stays disabled until its earlier answer exists.

Do: Disabled until the earlier answer is set.
Don't: An enabled field with no options to show.

### Show the chosen path in the field. {#show-the-chosen-path-in-the-field}

A filled field shows the choice; an empty one cannot confirm it. `value` is the whole path, outermost value first, and `onChange` fires with the path as each column is chosen. Pass and read the whole array, since the levels between are part of the answer.

Do: The field shows the whole chosen path.
Don't: An empty field after a choice cannot confirm it.

### Mark a failed pick on the field. {#mark-a-failed-pick-on-the-field}

With `isInvalid`, the field draws the danger border and `errorMessage` replaces the caption.

Do: A failed pick draws the danger border, so the error is seen at the field.
Don't: A failed pick still draws the normal border, so nothing marks the error.

## Accessibility

- **The field states the full path**, not just the deepest choice, so its
  accessible value matches what's visibly shown.
- **Without a visible label, name the field explicitly** with `aria-label`
  or `aria-labelledby`.
- **Disabled nodes are skipped, not just dimmed** — they take no focus and
  can't be chosen at any column.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | — |
| `name` | string | — | Submitted with a form through hidden inputs, one per path segment. |
| `label` | node | — | The visible label above the field. Without one, pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. |
| `caption` | node | — | Help under the field. With `isInvalid`, `errorMessage` takes its place and is announced. |
| `info` | node | — | Text for the info tooltip beside the label. |
| `value` | arrayOf | `NO_PATH` | — |
| `options` | arrayOf | `[]` | — |
| `onChange` | func | — | — |
| `placeholder` | string | `'Please select'` | Hint text shown in the field while no path is selected. Defaults to `Please select`. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` draws 40 and `compact` draws 32. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | — |
| `isRequired` | bool | `false` | Shows an asterisk on the label and sets `aria-required`. |
| `isInvalid` | bool | `false` | Draws the error border, sets `aria-invalid`, and `errorMessage` becomes the announced caption. |
| `errorMessage` | node | — | — |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `style` | object | — | — |
